results.name: Serra da Arrábida Natural Park
results.attraction_type: Coastal natural park (limestone cliffs & Mediterranean forest)
results.principal_activities: Hiking, secluded beaches (Portinho da Arrábida, Praia dos Coelhos, Praia de Galapinhos), snorkelling, scuba diving, kayaking, dolphin watching, wine tasting (Moscatel de Setúbal)

results.name: Cabo da Roca
results.attraction_type: Sea cliffs / westernmost point of continental Europe
results.approximate_travel_time: ~50–60 min by car; ~1 h 20 min by bus via Sintra
results.principal_activities: Cliff-top walks, panoramic Atlantic views, sunset watching, photography, lighthouse visit

results.name: Praia do Guincho
results.principal_activities: Surfing, kitesurfing, windsurfing, beach walks, birdwatching in surrounding dunes

results.name: Praia da Adraga
results.principal_activities: Swimming, coastal walks among sea stacks, photography, rock-pool exploration

results.name: Praia da Ursa
results.approximate_travel_time: ~50 min by car + 20 min hike down
results.principal_activities: Hiking (steep cliff trail), wild swimming, dramatic rock-formation viewing

results.name: Serra de Sintra forests (Sintra-Cascais Natural Park)
results.principal_activities: Forest hiking, trail running, visiting the Capuchos Convent (cork-lined hermitage in the woods), birdwatching

results.name: Berlengas Islands (UNESCO Biosphere Reserve)
results.approximate_travel_time: ~1 h 20 min drive to Peniche + 30 min boat
results.principal_activities: Hiking to lighthouse, snorkelling, diving, kayaking through sea caves, birdwatching (seabird colonies), visiting São João Baptista fortress

results.name: Cabo Espichel
results.principal_activities: Dinosaur-footprint fossil viewing, cliff walks, dramatic coastal scenery, photography

results.name: Costa da Caparica beaches
results.attraction_type: Long Atlantic beach strip backed by dunes & pine forest
results.principal_activities: Beach-going, surfing, coastal dune walks, beach-hopping by mini-train along the coast

results.name: Lagoa de Albufeira
results.attraction_type: Coastal lagoon connected to the sea
results.principal_activities: Lagoon swimming, windsurfing, stand-up paddleboarding, birdwatching, beach walks
